name: Service Level 1 Code
definition: Specifies the pre-agreed level of service between the parties.

SEPA.name: Single Euro Payments Area
SEPA.definition: Payment must be executed following the Single Euro Payments Area scheme.

SDVA.name: Same Day Value
SDVA.definition: Payment must be executed with same day value to the creditor.

PRPT.name: EBA Priority Service
PRPT.definition: Transaction must be processed according to the EBA|Priority Service.
